Kiến trúc Hệ thống

Hình 1: Kiến trúc Hệ thống — Tương tác giữa các module và luồng dữ liệu

Giao tiếp giữa các Module

TừĐếnSự kiệnGiao thứcMô tả
AUTHSMSverification.requestedRabbitMQAUTH publishes when user requests account verification
AUTHSMSverification.resentRabbitMQAUTH publishes when user resends verification (rate-limited)
SMSAUTHverification.deliveredWebhookSMS confirms delivery status back to AUTH
AUTHLOGauth.event.loggedRabbitMQAUTH publishes any auth event (login, logout, register, password change) to Logger
SMSLOGsms.event.loggedRabbitMQSMS publishes delivery events (sent, delivered, failed) to Logger
AUTHEMAILverification.email.requestedRabbitMQAUTH publishes when user requests email verification
AUTHEMAILverification.email.resentRabbitMQAUTH publishes when user resends email verification (rate-limited)
EMAILAUTHverification.email.deliveredWebhookEMAIL confirms delivery status back to AUTH
EMAILLOGemail.event.loggedRabbitMQEMAIL publishes email delivery events (sent, delivered, failed) to Logger
RECREMAILapplication.submittedRabbitMQRECR publishes when candidate submits application
RECREMAILinterview.scheduledRabbitMQRECR publishes when interview is scheduled
RECREMAILoffer.sentRabbitMQRECR publishes when offer letter is sent
RECRLOGrecruitment.event.loggedRabbitMQRECR publishes recruitment events (application, interview, offer) to Logger
WALLETRECRwallet.payment.completedRabbitMQWALLET publishes when payment for job posting or featured job is completed
WALLETLOGwallet.event.loggedRabbitMQWALLET publishes wallet events (deposit, withdrawal, transfer, payment) to Logger
AUTHWALLETuser.registeredRabbitMQAUTH publishes when new user registers, WALLET creates wallet
